Trigger An ally in range is about to attempt a recovery check

Cost 1 Encore

Traits Signal

You spend 1 Encore. The triggering ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to that recovery check. This costs you no action. The bonus is not a fortune effect, so it is compatible with any reroll. It is a circumstance bonus like Requiem's own +2, so the two do not stack -- the ally applies the higher, +4.
